text: 魏文侯去世后，吴起转而事奉他的儿子武侯。这时魏国任命宰相，用了田文。吴起很不高兴，去找田文比功劳。他一连比了三件事。统领三军，让士兵乐意为国拼命，敌国不敢打魏国的主意，你比我怎样？田文说：「不如子」，不如你。镇守西河，让秦兵不敢向东进犯，韩、赵两国都来归附，你比我怎样？田文还是说不如你。治理百官、亲近百姓、充实国库，你比我怎样？田文仍说不如你。三件比完，吴起问：这三件你都在我之下，职位却在我之上，这是为什么？

After Marquis Wen died, Wu Qi served his son, Marquis Wu. Wei then appointed a chief minister and chose Tian Wen. Wu Qi was displeased and challenged Tian Wen to compare their merits. He compared them on three counts. In command of the armies, making soldiers glad to die and enemy states afraid to plot against Wei, how do you compare with me? Tian Wen said: Not as well as you. Holding Xihe, so that Qin's troops dare not march east and Han and Zhao come as guests, how do you compare with me? Again Tian Wen said he could not match him. Governing the officials, winning the people's affection and filling the treasury, how do you compare with me? Once more Tian Wen said he could not match him. When the three were done, Wu Qi asked: in all three you rank below me, yet your post ranks above mine. Why?
在楚国，楚悼王早就听说他贤能，让他做了宰相。他严明法令，裁掉不急需的官员，罢免与王室血缘疏远的公族，集中力量强兵，楚国强盛起来，各国都忧虑楚国的强大。史书写道，因此楚国的贵戚都想害他。悼王一死，王族大臣作乱，攻击吴起；吴起跑到悼王遗体处，伏在遗体上，攻击他的人又射又刺吴起，也击中了悼王的遗体。悼王下葬、太子即位后，下令把射吴起时也射中了王尸的人全部处死，因此被灭族的有七十多家。

In Chu, King Dao, who had long heard of his ability, made him chief minister. He made the laws clear and strict, cut offices that were not needed, dismissed royal kinsmen of distant blood, and put the state's strength into its army; Chu grew strong, and the other states feared its power. For this reason, the history says, Chu's nobles all wanted him dead. When King Dao died, members of the royal clan rose up and attacked Wu Qi. He ran to the king's body and threw himself on it; his attackers shot and stabbed him, and struck the king's body too. After King Dao was buried and the crown prince came to the throne, he had everyone who had shot at Wu Qi and also struck the king's body put to death, and more than seventy families were wiped out for it.
本篇史源单一，仅《史記·孫子吳起列傳》（维基文库本）。文中对话、士兵母亲的话和公叔之仆的计策都是史书的记述，未必逐字实录。人物评语分别出自鲁国进言者（“猜忍”）、李克（“贪而好色”）和公叔之仆（“节廉而自喜名”）；这些是当事人的评价，不是史家的定论。吴起在楚国的改革与结局只概述史书所记。标为“作者推断”的段落属于作者解释；思考题中的场景是虚构的。

This piece rests on a single source, the biography of Sunzi and Wu Qi in the Records of the Grand Historian (Wikisource text). The dialogues, the soldier's mother's words and the servant's plan are the history's account and need not be verbatim. The judgments of Wu Qi come from his accuser in Lu (suspicious and ruthless), from Li Ke (greedy and fond of women) and from Gongshu's servant (a man of integrity who prized his name); these are the speakers' own judgments, not the historian's verdict. His reforms and death in Chu are summarized only as the history tells them. The paragraph marked as the author's inference is interpretation; the scenario in the question is fictional.
